accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 2 and its calibration proposition
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The result is conditional on exact known fixed rank and dependence range, independent rows, finite-range within-row dependence, common stationary covariance, restricted-Gram geometry, and a positive local-to-global signal ratio.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Uniform Wald coverage under the displayed deterministic-MNAR weak-signal class, not under unknown rank, heterogeneous row covariance, or unrestricted serial dependence.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies PC estimation in high-dimensional approximate factor models with weak factors and treats temporal dependence, rather than a masked nuclear-norm causal completion estimator.

The article obtains inference after nuclear-norm penalization without sample splitting and uses a hypothetical auxiliary leave-one-out estimator in its technical argument; its implemented final procedure is a two-step least-squares estimator.

The paper concerns Tucker tensor-factor imputation with general missingness, loading-row asymptotic normality, and consistent covariance estimation; it does not state a causal common-component growing-window theorem.
